function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
It really depends on *what* you’re aiming for—whether it’s an outfit for work, a casual outing, a special event, or simply something comfortable at home—and also your personal style preferences and how cream looks against your complexion. Below are some quick guidelines to help you decide: | Situation | Why Cream Might Work (Pros) | Potential Drawbacks / Things to Watch | |-----------|-----------------------------|--------------------------------------| | **Professional setting** | • Neutral & polished look
• Works well under dark suits or blazers
• Easy to pair with navy, charcoal, burgundy, or even subtle patterns | • Too light may feel “washed out” in very bright office lighting
• Pair with darker accessories so it doesn’t blend into the background | | **Casual weekend** | • Soft, relaxed vibe
• Great base for denim, khaki, or pastel layers
• Looks fresh in spring/summer | • Can appear too plain without contrast – add texture (linen, tweed) or accent pieces (scarves, belts) | | **Evening/social events** | • Elegant when paired with metallics or jewel tones
• Good canvas for statement jewelry or bold shoes | • In dim lighting, cream can lose definition – consider adding a pop of color through accessories | | **Outdoor activities** | • Light weight, breathable fabrics (cotton, linen)
• Reflective quality keeps you cooler | • May show stains more easily; choose high‑quality fabric or blends | ### Quick Tips for Wearing Cream-Colored Clothes 1. **Skin Tone Matters** - **Cool undertones:** Cream tends to warm up cool complexions slightly. To balance, layer with cool-toned neutrals (gray, navy) or use blue-based creams rather than yellowish ones. - **Warm undertones:** Cream complements naturally; try deeper browns or olive greens for contrast. 2. **Layer Smartly** - Add depth with textured outerwear—a tweed blazer, corduroy jacket, or a lightweight wool coat. - Use scarves or hats in complementary hues (deep teal, maroon, mustard). 3. **Accessorize Wisely** - Metallic accents (gold or silver) bring sparkle. - Bold colored bags or shoes create focal points. 4. **Fabric Choice** - Linen or cotton works best for airy summer outfits. - Wool or cashmere keep warmth while maintaining structure for fall/winter. 5. **Pattern Play** - Subtle stripes or checks in cream can break monotony. - Avoid overly busy prints directly over cream unless balanced with solid elements. --- #### Bottom Line: If you enjoy neutral palettes, have a good sense of layering, and don’t mind mixing textures, cream-colored garments can be a versatile staple. They’ll shine especially in settings where understated elegance is appreciated. However, if you prefer vibrant pops of color or a highly contrasting aesthetic, you might lean toward richer shades instead. Feel free to let me know what specific occasion or wardrobe piece you had in mind—I’d love to give tailored styling ideas!
